Details 
 Vista hat is a performance ranch hat built for everyday wear with modern western style and lightweight comfort. Designed as a breathable country hat, the Vista is made from Delta Hydro Flex material that helps wick moisture, resist stains, and keep you cool during long days outside. This western hat is made for work, travel, and summer weather when you need something comfortable but durable.
 The Hydro Flex construction makes this country hat lightweight and flexible while still holding its shape. The material is water friendly and floats, making this ranch hat a great choice for warm weather, outdoor activities, and everyday use. The clean shield logo design gives this western hat a modern look that still fits the classic Kimes Ranch style.
 Built for comfort and durability, the Vista pairs easily with your favorite Kimes Ranch jeans, tees, hoodies, and performance shirts. Whether you are at the barn, on the road, or outside all day, this ranch hat is made to keep up.
 With breathable comfort, strong construction, and clean western style, the Vista is a country hat designed for people who want performance without giving up classic ranch looks.
 Fabric: Hybrid Spandex/Jersey
 Fit: Adjustable Snapback | High-Profile | Flat Bill
 Details: Silicone Logo, Perforated Back Panels
